chunks: And from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
When two believers meet and shake hands, Allah puts His Hand in between and it is shaken by the one who loves the other the most.
ai.seo_question: What happens when two believers shake hands according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.), the physical act of greeting is elevated to a spiritual encounter where Allah’s presence is tangible, specifically favoring the one with greater love (mawaddah) for their companion. This reflects the Shia emphasis on the metaphysical reality of social bonds, where emotional sincerity is rewarded with divine acknowledgment. It underscores that the handshake is not merely a custom but a moment of grace where the believer’s heart is weighed by God.
